<section class="page-intro"><div class="eyebrow">Research</div><h1>Research</h1><p class="lead">My research examines what drives consumer choice and how consumer valuations and choices evolve over time. Drawing on individual-level longitudinal choice data and quantitative modeling, I study these questions in settings where experiential aspects play an important role, including live performances, charitable giving, and aesthetic product design.</p></section>
